changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question question SET content = jsonb_set(question.content, '{dragItems}', reduced.drag_items) FROM (SELECT candidate.id AS question_id, jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath' LIKE '%/%' AND unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath' NOT LIKE '/%' AND unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath' NOT LIKE '%://%' THEN jsonb_set(unnested.item, '{pictureFilePath}', to_jsonb(regexp_replace(unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath', '^.*/', ''))) ELSE unnested.item END ORDER BY unnested.position) AS drag_items FROM quiz_question candidate, jsonb_array_elements(candidate.content -> 'dragItems') WITH ORDINALITY AS unnested(item, position) WHERE jsonb_typeof(candidate.content -> 'dragItems') = 'array' GROUP BY candidate.id HAVING bool_or(unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath' LIKE '%/%' AND unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath' NOT LIKE '/%' AND unnested.item ->> 'pictureFilePath' NOT LIKE '%://%')) reduced WHERE question.id = reduced.question_id

UPDATE quiz_question question JOIN (SELECT question_id, drag_items FROM (SELECT question_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(reduced_item) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY position ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS drag_items, MAX(needs_reduction) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id) AS any_needs_reduction, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY position DESC) AS list_rank FROM (SELECT candidate.id AS question_id, unnested.position AS position, unnested.picture LIKE '%/%' AND unnested.picture NOT LIKE '/%' AND unnested.picture NOT LIKE '%://%' AS needs_reduction, IF(unnested.picture LIKE '%/%' AND unnested.picture NOT LIKE '/%' AND unnested.picture NOT LIKE '%://%', JSON_SET(unnested.item, '$.pictureFilePath', SUBSTRING_INDEX(unnested.picture, '/', -1)), unnested.item) AS reduced_item FROM quiz_question candidate, JSON_TABLE(candidate.content, '$.dragItems[*]' COLUMNS ( position FOR ORDINALITY, item JSON PATH '$', picture TEXT PATH '$.pictureFilePath')) unnested) items) ordered WHERE list_rank = 1 AND any_needs_reduction = TRUE) reduced ON reduced.question_id = question.id SET question.content = JSON_SET(question.content, '$.dragItems', reduced.drag_items)
